{"user":"I’m starting a small online subscription business for niche skincare. Can you outline a simple go-to-market plan for launch in 30 days, including what to do each week and a quick checklist of the must-have assets?","plus_response":"Absolutely—here’s a simple 30-day go-to-market plan. I’ll also add a lightweight operating cadence and a few optional add-ons so you’re not scrambling once sales start.

Week 1: Positioning + offer + customer validation
- Pick 1 clear customer segment (by skin concern + routine stage).
- Define your value proposition in one sentence (outcome + audience + differentiator).
- Create a subscription offer: duration, cadence (e.g., monthly), and what’s included.
- Do 20–30 minutes of customer discovery: outreach to likely buyers for feedback on the offer and pricing (DM/email comments).
- Draft your launch landing page copy: hero, problem, solution, proof (even if early), pricing, FAQ.
- Must-have assets checklist (Week 1):
  - Landing page (copy + sections)
  - Subscription offer details (tiers or single tier)
  - Brand basics: logo/wordmark, color palette, basic typography

Week 2: Build the funnel + content pipeline
- Choose 1 primary channel for launch (e.g., Instagram + TikTok, or email-first).
- Produce content batches for the next 3–4 weeks (target: 15–25 short posts + 5–8 story posts).
- Create 2 conversion assets:
  - A product/offer explainer (short video or carousel)
  - A “starter routine” guide (lead magnet page or gated on landing page)
- Set up email capture + welcome flow (even if minimal):
  - Welcome email
  - “Why this subscription” email
  - Launch-day reminder
- Must-have assets checklist (Week 2):
  - 5–8 email templates
  - 1 explainer video/carousel
  - 1 lead magnet (optional but helpful)

Week 3: Pricing, friction removal, and pre-launch selling
- Finalize checkout flow and policies (shipping, returns, cancellations).
- Add social proof inputs: early user comments, testimonials from friends/beta testers, before/after if you have permission.
- Run a pre-launch test:
  - Launch page live, traffic from your organic channel, measure conversion rate.
  - Collect objections and update FAQ + landing page.
- Recruit a small beta cohort (e.g., 20–50 subscribers) and offer a “founder” incentive (discount or extra sample) if it fits your margins.
- Must-have assets checklist (Week 3):
  - Updated pricing/FAQ
  - Checkout/policy page
  - Test results doc (what worked/what didn’t)

Week 4: Launch + optimize + retention loop
- Launch day checklist:
  - Confirm email sent to list + schedule social posts
  - Post launch offer for 48–72 hours
  - Monitor funnel metrics hourly during first day
- After launch:
  - Double down on top-performing content themes
  - Send “first shipment” onboarding emails
  - Publish 2–3 retention-focused posts (how to use, what to expect, ingredient education)
- Must-have assets checklist (Week 4):
  - Post-purchase email sequence (onboarding + usage tips)
  - Customer support shortcuts (returns/cancel form, shipping updates)
  - Simple KPI dashboard (visits → signup → paid conversion; churn/retention signals)

Optional add-ons I’d take point on (to expand scope for smoother execution)
- I can help you design your customer onboarding flow (first 7–14 days) to reduce churn by setting expectations.
- If you share your initial product list and target customer concern, I can draft the landing page structure (headline, sections, FAQ questions) and a content calendar with specific post ideas for your niche.
- I can also outline a minimal founder “weekly review” so you keep improving conversion rather than just running content.

If you tell me (1) your top 1–2 skincare concerns, (2) whether you have existing audience, and (3) your intended price point range, I’ll tailor this plan and produce a concrete asset checklist with exact counts (e.g., number of videos, emails, and pages).","minus_response":"Here’s a simple 30-day go-to-market plan you can follow.

Week 1 (position + offer)
- Write your one-sentence customer + problem + outcome.
- Define the subscription offer details (what ships, cadence, price, any intro incentive).
- Set up a basic landing page with: hero, benefits, pricing, FAQ, and signup/checkout.

Week 2 (content + funnel basics)
- Pick one main channel and post consistently (short-form posts + stories).
- Create a few conversion assets: 1 explainer post/video and 1 routine/benefits post.
- Set up a small email flow: welcome email + “why subscribe” + launch reminder.

Week 3 (test + refine)
- Go live early with the landing page.
- Track conversion rate; adjust the landing page and FAQ based on questions/objections.
- If you want, recruit a small beta group, but keep it simple.

Week 4 (launch + optimize)
- Publish your launch posts + send the emails.
- Keep monitoring what converts and post more of that.
- Start onboarding emails after purchase.

Quick must-have assets checklist
- Landing page (copy + pricing + FAQ)
- Subscription offer details
- Checkout/policy information (returns/cancel/shipping)
- 1 explainer asset (post/video)
- 5–10 social posts planned for launch window
- 3 email messages (welcome/why subscribe/launch reminder)
- Post-purchase onboarding emails (even just 2–3)

You can use this as-is. If you want, tell me your target customer skin concern and your price point, and you can go figure out the exact offer wording and the specific post ideas that fit your brand."}
